_readme: The control surface for brand marks. Edit this file, run `node build-anaha.mjs`,
and Studio hot-reloads in about a second — no re-render needed while iterating.
file  — a filename inside media/logos/. Missing files render as a labelled
placeholder, so you can lay the whole edit out before you have assets.
at    — seconds. Seeded from transcript.json, i.e. the moment it is SAID.
w     — width in px on the 1080x1920 stage (height follows the aspect).
Slots avoid the furniture: top row sits below the 250px platform chrome and
above the face; it also stays clear of the PiP (top-right, 62.45-92.35s).
`wall` is a full-frame card for B-roll moments — stack several marks in one

logos.note: sponsor pair on the thanks beat — mirrors the CapCut cut
